title: WS4 — wire relief engines (E6 grain → E9 subtractive carve) into the lab renderer

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The E6 grain field reproduces the lab tectonic oracle (equator→thrust, mid-latitude→strike-slip, pole→normal) and is deterministic per (drivers, seed).

verifyVia.input: Run the grain derivation headless for a fixed (drivers, seed) bundle.
verifyVia.observable: Regime classification matches the oracle per latitude band; re-running yields byte-identical fields.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: With grain ON, the relief features (mountains, scarps, tessera, canyons) read their strike/orientation from the ONE shared grain field, not independent per-feature hashed axes.

verifyVia.input: Enable grain on the lab planet on :9223 and probe each grained feature's orientation source.
verifyVia.observable: Each grained feature's strike correlates to the shared grain field; a uniform/window probe confirms one field feeds N consumers (no independent random axis remains).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: With uTectonicGrainStrength = 0, the rendered planet is byte-identical to the pre-WS4 baseline (safe fallback).

verifyVia.input: Set grain strength 0 on :9223 and A/B against a pre-WS4 baseline capture.
verifyVia.observable: GPU capture identical within tolerance to baseline; uniform probe shows the fallback path is taken.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The drainage carve is strictly subtractive: carved height ≤ authored height at every vertex, with 0 uphill and 0 orphan edges.

verifyVia.input: Run the carve over a fixed body headless.
verifyVia.observable: Per-vertex carved ≤ authored everywhere; routing reports 0 uphill, 0 orphan.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Epoch 1 (E6 build) is bit-identical with the carve disabled, and epoch 2 (E9) only lowers height (monotone non-increasing).

verifyVia.input: Snapshot the epoch-1 build with carve disabled, then run epoch 2 headless.
verifyVia.observable: Build-only snapshot bit-identical with carve off; epoch-2 height delta ≤ 0 at every vertex.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Flipping the carve epoch off→on on the lab planet reads as 'uncut relief' → 'drainage carved into the SAME relief' — valley floors are genuinely lower.

verifyVia.input: Toggle the carve epoch off/on on :9223 over a built relief and probe valley-pixel heights.
verifyVia.observable: Valley-pixel height/depth decreases when the epoch turns on; the carve sits in the same relief that was just built.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The router-lab zero-drift regression stays green (ocean ~35%, maxStrahler ~5, 0 orphan/uphill) and sphere-mapping is correct: both poles clean, lakes intact.

verifyVia.input: Run the router-lab regression headless and inspect both poles on :9223.
verifyVia.observable: Regression metrics within their bands; both poles render clean; lakes intact.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The grain+carve bake runs once per (preset, seed), not per-frame; the grain bake re-bakes only on seed/preset change (it is tectonic — derived from drivers+seed, independent of sea level) and stays within the documented bake budget.

verifyVia.input: Change camera/time (no re-bake expected), then change seed/preset/sea-level (re-bake expected) on :9223.
verifyVia.observable: Bake counter = 1 per preset/seed; unchanged on camera/time AND on sea-level change (grain is sea-level-independent); increments by exactly 1 on seed/preset change; within budget.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No strike-axis derivation or relief-amplitude decision remains in the shader for grained features; the shader only expresses the grain/substrate fields.

verifyVia.input: Code-audit planet-lod-height.glsl.js and the shader paths for grained features.
verifyVia.observable: For the six grained combiners, the strike axis comes through the grain cube via mix(oldAxis, grainStrike, uTectonicGrainStrength) (fbmdRidged:881 vec2-projected, canyonCombiner:1917, scarpCombiner:1955, tesseraCombiner:2102/2110, lavaPlainsCombiner:2189, cryoRidgeCombiner:2621/2631) — no raw per-feature axis hashing remains for them (the six deriveUniforms hashes orogeny:662/chasma:685/scarp:707/tessera:725/lava:772/cryo:888 + the seededUnitVec3:483 primitive become the strength=0 endpoint only, and the four grained-axis 🎲 rerolls orogeny:3715/chasma:3728/scarp:3743/tessera:3769 are gated). initProvinces:797 / gProvince:796 / provinceWeight:811 are EXPLICITLY PRESERVED (amplitude/where, augmented behind uProvinceWeight per Max decision #6 — NOT replaced); the in-shader gProvince rotation of the grain strike (orientation composition) reads, never replaces, that field.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Looking at the planet as a whole, the relief reads as the coherent result of the forces that formed it (landforms belong to a tectonic system, not random scatter) AND drainage has cut into that relief — a clear step toward 'you can see the forces that formed it.'

verifyVia.input: Max walks a built world on :9223 with grain + carve on.
verifyVia.observable: Max judges the whole-disk read coheres as tectonic relief + drainage with a history.

inputs: WS2 base-step outputs — src/worldengine/base/tectonic.js writeGrainSphere + the F3 carrier (grain inputs).
E6 math reference: relief-e6-tectonic.js (reference, not drop-in).
outputs: planet-lod-height.glsl.js relief features — the renderer stops deriving STRIKE/ORIENTATION for grained features and instead expresses the shared grain field. The REPLACE-SET is the six combiner axis reads (fbmdRidged:881 [vec2 xz, projected from the cube's vec3 strike], canyonCombiner:1917, scarpCombiner:1955, tesseraCombiner:2102/2110, lavaPlainsCombiner:2189, cryoRidgeCombiner:2621/2631) + their six deriveUniforms hashes (orogeny:662, chasma:685, scarp:707, tessera:725, lava:772, cryo:888) + the seededUnitVec3:483 primitive + the four grained-axis GUI rerolls (orogeny:3715 [Math.random angle, NOT randUnitVec3], chasma:3728, scarp:3743, tessera:3769). Each old uXxxAxis remains as the uTectonicGrainStrength=0 endpoint (branch-guarded byte-identical fallback).

PRESERVED (augment, NOT replace — Max decision #6): initProvinces:797, gProvince:796, provinceWeight:811 (amplitude/where masks). The grain composes ORIENTATION against gProvince IN-SHADER (a province-keyed rotation of the cube strike) — it reads gProvince, never replaces it. (Note: initProvinces does AMPLITUDE, not axis hashing; the prior 'replace per-feature axis hashing at initProvinces:797 / fbmdRidged:880' wording conflated two mechanisms and is corrected here. lava:3801 and cryo:3825 GUI rerolls touch only OFFSETS, not axes, and need no gate.)
New module: planet-lod-tectonic.js (bakeTectonicGrain → strike-only cube field).
New pure helper in planet-lod-rivers.js: perNodeIncision (the per-mesh-node Δ≤0 carve operand; buildValleyGeometry aDepth + the carve cube R channel both derive from it).
Derivation added in deriveUniforms; grain cube uniform (uTectonicGrainCube) + uTectonicGrainStrength in planet-lod-uniforms.js.
rotatePoleDeg=0 param added to writeGrainSphere (src/worldengine/base/tectonic.js:53) — a deliberate, byte-identical-at-default WS2 addition (outside src/generation/).
Orchestration host: createRiverOverlay (planet-lod-rivers.js:797) — bakes the grain cube once per body inside route().
mustStayWorking: Router-lab zero-drift regression (planet-lod-rivers.js routeAndOrder:283, buildValleyGeometry:595; ocean ~35%, maxStrahler ~5, 0 orphan/uphill).
The shipped rivers feature's scale + water-fill.
